svg.title: System-check accuracy on combinations left out of training
svg.text: System checks on a combination the GRU never trained on
Share of pass/fail verdicts predicted correctly on new sessions of each combination left out of training.
Bars: average of three training seeds. Lines: lowest to highest seed.
